decision_rules.decision_context: A manager wants cost savings but quality, reliability, or impact evidence may be weakened.
decision_rules.default_low_complexity_choice: Protect safety, reliability, and trust before accepting a cost reduction.
choose_this_when: savings remove waste without reducing reliability or customer outcome
quality evidence remains valid after the change
frontline teams can execute the new method without workarounds
avoid_this_when: savings rely on lower inspection discipline, weaker materials, unproven substitutions, or hidden labor strain
risk_of_wrong_choice: false economy through rework or recalls
